cards.card_text: He even wants that night cursed by those who curse the day, the ones prepared to rouse Leviathan.
cards.verse_text: May it be cursed by those who curse the day—those prepared to rouse Leviathan.
cards.snippet: …it be cursed by those who curse the day—those prepared to rouse Leviathan.

cards.card_text: Then the LORD turns to another creature, Leviathan: "Can you pull in Leviathan with a hook or tie down his tongue with a rope?"
cards.verse_text: “Can you pull in Leviathan with a hook or tie down his tongue with a rope?

cards.verse_text: No one is so fierce as to rouse Leviathan.
cards.snippet: No one is so fierce as to rouse Leviathan.

cards.verse_text: You crushed the heads of Leviathan; You fed him to the creatures of the desert.

cards.card_text: Ships sail through, and so does Leviathan, and friend, I'd be the one on deck pointing and yelling for everybody to come LOOK.
cards.verse_text: There the ships pass, and Leviathan, which You formed to frolic there.
cards.snippet: There the ships pass, and Leviathan, which You formed to frolic there.

cards.card_text: Out in that vast sea is Leviathan.

cards.card_text: He will bring judgment on Leviathan, the fleeing serpent, the coiling serpent.
cards.verse_text: In that day the LORD will take His sharp, great, and mighty sword, and bring judgment on Leviathan the fleeing serpent—Leviathan the coiling serpent—and He will slay the dragon of the sea.
